dedupe_keys.name: e4drr eastern africa flood and drought event storylines

description: E4DRR publishes selected flood and drought event storylines for disaster-risk work in Eastern Africa. ICPAC and NORCAP present country tables with event periods, available EM-DAT identifiers and cited narratives about impacts and responses. The April 2025 pages cover 11 countries; selected drought periods extend from 2016 to 2023 and flood events from 2019 to 2024. These are country-event summaries with varying date precision, not a continuous observation series or a complete disaster census. The public Markdown pages and rendered website are free to read, and the repository states CC BY 4.0. Third-party source material retains its original conditions. A limitation is uneven evidence: several rows have no EM-DAT match, some narratives mix drought impacts with other drivers, and the Uganda flood table contains an impossible September 31 end date. Those values require correction against the cited sources before modelling. Simulation uses include choosing historical scenario periods and tracing reported service or livelihood disruption. The tables relate to data-em-dat while adding selected contextual narratives. No impact totals were independently verified, and the project’s planned hazard pipelines are not treated as released simulation software.
